strategy.offer: Software, databases, web services, analyses, operational services and training that digitize energy-sector sales, billing, market communication and related business processes.
strategy.customers: Energy-sector companies, especially utilities, suppliers and other market participants needing tariff, network, billing and market-process support.
strategy.why_we_win: Daily updated reliable market data, precise calculations, personal support, configurable integrations and a central platform combining internal and third-party applications.
strategy.resources: Experienced staff, maintained market-data databases, certified data-capture and quality processes, hosting capabilities, industry know-how, and the ability to build standard or custom solutions.
strategy.direction: Expanding a central platform for everyday operations, adding integrated applications and services, and strengthening customers’ digital transformation capabilities.
